data.narrative:
ideaForge is a public-stage company in the Drones & Autonomous sector that has raised $50M+. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 7 private peers in the sector, including Joby Aviation, Archer Aviation, Zipline, Nuro, and Elroy Air. No public comparables exist in this narrow sector.

The peer-median approach is not applicable here. The Drones & Autonomous sector contains only 5 same-sector peers overall, and filtering by stage, adjacency, or valuation tier yields fewer than the 3 datapoints required for statistical reliability. A median derived from the full sector set would obscure material differences in business model, technology maturity, and capital intensity across the peer group.

With triangulation methods constrained by data insufficiency, this valuation cannot be anchored to a derived range at this time. The primary uncertainty is the absence of both public market benchmarks and a sufficiently dense private comp set with disclosed metrics (revenue, burn rate, path to profitability) that would enable revenue multiple or DCF-based cross-checks. Resolution would require either disclosure of financial performance within the existing peer set or emergence of additional public comparables in autonomous systems. ideaForge's own disclosed metrics—revenue, customer concentration, and capex requirements—would be necessary to apply stage-appropriate valuation frameworks.
